title: Analista financeiro e controladoria [PJ] [Remoto]
description:
Analista Financeiro de Controladoria (PJ) - Remoto


Remuneração: R$ 3.900/mês

Modelo: 100% remoto

Início: Dezembro 2025 a Janeiro 2026


Estamos estruturando a próxima onda de escala operacional da Back4You e buscamos uma profissional para operar a inteligência financeira das clínicas e médicos atendidos.


Sobre a função

O papel é de ponta a ponta: fechar o DRE mensal, liderar a implementação do ERP no cliente (sistema Nibo), traduzir dados em narrativa financeira acionável e fortalecer a governança que sustenta decisões tributárias e operacionais.


Responsabilidades-chave

• Fechamento mensal do DRE: plano de contas, rateios, centros de custo, conciliações e ajustes estruturantes.

• Implementação de ERP financeiro: diagnóstico inicial, parametrização, definição da jornada e treinamento do cliente para implementação. O preenchimento de dados e conciliação é inicialmente com base no ERP.

• Reunião de onboarding técnica: conduzir a sessão inicial combinando implantação + aula de princípios financeiros para garantir compreensão do porquê, do como e dos indicadores a serem acompanhados.

• Reuniões quinzenais durante a implantação para garantir tração, maturidade de uso e aderência do time do cliente.

• Pós-implantação: análises robustas de centros de custo, comportamento de gastos, margens, tributação, pricing e eficiência operacional com ao menos uma reunião mensal com cliente com relatório executivo com recomendações (registrado), oportunidades e plano de ação.

• Construção e recomendações do fluxo de caixa (curto e médio prazo).

• Registro de todas as interações e entregas no sistema interno de gestão

• Gestão de carteira: até 40 clientes de pequeno porte; acima disso, há reprecificação.


Requisitos técnicos

• Experiência prévia em controladoria e implantação de ERP financeiro.

• Domínio de centros de custo, conciliações e fechamento mensal.

• Segurança para conduzir reuniões com clientes e traduzir dados em insights de gestão.

• Noções sólidas de tributação de pessoas jurídicas.


Diferenciais

• Vivência com clínicas, consultórios ou operações de saúde.

• Familiaridade com Nibo (BPO).

• Mindset para eficiência, margem e governança financeira.


O profissional ideal eleva a maturidade financeira, acelera o ROI da implementação e cria capacidade analítica para suportar decisões tributárias estratégicas. Esta é uma posição de alto impacto direto no nível executivo dos clientes.

title: Cloud Application Architect (AWS)
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com Cloud Application Architect


Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar soluções AWS adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes, com foco em requisitos corporativos
  • Executar tarefas técnicas ao longo da entrega do projeto, incluindo implementação da solução, testes e implantação
  • Levantar requisitos e implementar estratégias de migração para aplicações dos clientes
  • Aplicar boas práticas da AWS e tecnologias emergentes em cenários reais
  • Contribuir com conhecimento por meio de documentação, artefatos reutilizáveis e colaboração com o time


Requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação e experiência prática
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência na entrega de soluções corporativas, com experiência em plataformas enterprise (Java EE, .NET Framework) e desenvolvimento em nuvem
  • Experiência na modernização de aplicações em Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, C#, Go ou Ruby para AWS
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura moderna de aplicações, incluindo APIs, microsserviços, arquiteturas serverless, conteinerização e DevOps
  • Capacidade de se comunicar efetivamente em inglês em ambientes técnicos e de negócios


Desejável:


  • Experiência com SOA, ESB e arquitetura em múltiplas camadas (n-tier)
  • Capacidade de se comunicar efetivamente em espanhol em ambientes técnicos e de negócios
  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • AWS Certified Developer – Associate


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Cloud Application Architect (AWS)
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com Cloud Application Architect


Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar soluções AWS adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes, com foco em requisitos corporativos
  • Executar tarefas técnicas ao longo da entrega do projeto, incluindo implementação da solução, testes e implantação
  • Levantar requisitos e implementar estratégias de migração para aplicações dos clientes
  • Aplicar boas práticas da AWS e tecnologias emergentes em cenários reais
  • Contribuir com conhecimento por meio de documentação, artefatos reutilizáveis e colaboração com o time


Requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação e experiência prática

title: Estrategista de mídias sociais
description:
Estamos em busca de um Social Media criativo, organizado e apaixonado por comunicação digital  para integrar nossa equipe! Se você domina redes sociais, tem olhar estratégico e sabe transformar ideias em conteúdos que engajam, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades
  • Criar, planejar e executar conteúdos para redes sociais (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, etc.).
  • Desenvolver cronogramas de postagem e acompanhar os resultados das publicações.
  • Produzir textos criativos, legendas e roteiros para vídeos.
  • Atender a comunidade online: responder comentários, mensagens e interagir com o público.
  • Monitorar métricas de desempenho e gerar relatórios com insights e oportunidades.
  • Acompanhar tendências, memes, hashtags e novidades do universo digital.
  • Colaborar com equipe de design, tráfego e marketing para campanhas integradas.

    • Requisitos
    • Formação em Marketing ou Publicidade e Propaganda
    • Experiência prévia como Social Media ou funções semelhantes.
    • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão e análise (Meta Business, Creator Studio, RD Station, Metricool, mLabs ou similares).
    • Excelente escrita, criatividade e domínio da língua portuguesa.
    • Conhecimento em estratégias de conteúdo, storytelling e funil digital.
    • Capacidade de organização, proatividade e boa comunicação.
    • Diferencial: noções de edição de vídeo, design básico e SEO para redes sociais.


    O que oferecemos
    • Ambiente colaborativo, criativo e aberto a novas ideias.
    • Oportunidade de crescimento e participação em projetos estratégicos da marca.
    • Flexibilidade e autonomia para desenvolvimento das atividades.
    • PJ.
    • Remuneração a combinar.
    • Presencial.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Estagiário administrativo
description:
A CCM Engenharia busca um estagiário(a) para apoiar as rotinas administrativas relacionadas à logística de viagens corporativas, controle documental, acompanhamento de cobranças e suporte ao setor financeiro-operacional. O candidato atuará diretamente na organização de demandas internas, garantindo agilidade, precisão e rastreabilidade dos processos da empresa.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Auxiliar na logística de viagens da equipe (passagens, hospedagens, veículos, agendas e suporte aos consultores em campo).
  • Organizar informações de deslocamentos, reembolsos e comprovantes de despesas.
  • Conferir e validar notas fiscais, cobranças, faturas e lançamentos relacionados às operações.
  • Realizar contato com fornecedores, hotéis, locadoras e parceiros logísticos quando necessário.
  • Apoiar rotinas internas de compliance documental aplicadas aos projetos.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Excel intermediário (organização, filtros, tabelas dinâmicas simples).
  • Boa capacidade de organização e gestão de informações.
  • Comunicação clara e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade de 20–30 horas semanais.
Desejáveis
  • Experiência prévia em atividades administrativas, logística ou financeiro.
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas em ambiente dinâmico.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Organização e rigor no acompanhamento de processos.
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Capacidade de comunicação eficaz com diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar com prazos e demandas simultâneas.
  • Discrição e confiabilidade no manuseio de informações internas.
Benefícios
  • Bolsa compatível com o mercado.
  • Possibilidade de crescimento para áreas administrativas, financeiras ou operacionais da CCM.
  • Ambiente de trabalho estruturado, com autonomia gradual conforme desempenho.
  • Treinamentos internos e exposição a projetos corporativos de grande porte.

title: Azure Data Engineer
description:
We are currently looking for a Portuguese speaking Data Engineer to work across Microsoft Azure solutions in delivering proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in remotely in Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end data architecture solutions on Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
  • Architect and optimize Data Lake storage solutions for structured and unstructured data.
  • Leverage Azure Databricks for big data processing, analytics, and machine learning workflows.
  • Integrate Azure Machine Learning models into data pipelines and business applications.
  • Design and maintain Azure SQL databases, ensuring performance, scalability, and security.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Professional English written and oral communication
  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or similar role in a cloud-first environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Azure Foundry, Data Factory, Data Lake, Databricks, and Azure SQL.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and its integration into enterprise data platforms.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts and deployment in Azure ML.
  • Expertise in data modeling, data warehousing, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code.


If you are interested in working with premier enterprise businesses across The Americas, then please apply!


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js) - Remote – Brazil or Mexico
description:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + Node.js)

Location: Remote – Brazil or Mexico


About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Full Stack Engineer with strong expertise in Java-based distributed systems and stream-based processing. In this role, you will design, build, and operate backend services that support high-throughput workloads, integrate with cloud platforms, and enable critical business applications. You will also work with Node.js services, CI/CD pipelines, and modern infrastructure tooling such as Kubernetes and GitHub Actions across AWS and GCP.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Node.js .
  • Build and optimize message-driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka .
  • Develop scalable and resilient APIs and backend services.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following industry best practices.
  • Deploy, monitor, and support applications running in Kubernetes across multiple cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations.
  • Participate in code reviews, system design discussions, and operational readiness efforts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure layers.
  • Prototype emerging technologies to reduce costs and increase engineering velocity.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java in backend or distributed systems.
  • Practical expertise in Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, topics, offsets, stream processing).
  • Proficiency in Node.js for backend development.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining services in Kubernetes .
  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or GCP .
  • Strong understanding of design patterns, system architecture, and microservices.
  • Experience with MongoDB and PostgreSQL (schema design, performance, migrations).
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a distributed team environment.

Nice to Have

  • VOD / Streaming platform experience.
  • Experience with React for basic frontend integrations, context management, and UI components.
  • Exposure to IaC tools such as Terraform , Helm , etc.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog or New Relic .

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to support the development of personalized search capabilities and data assimilation initiatives within the organization. This is a remote role aligned to the EST time zone . The ideal candidate will have strong experience working with Python, databricks, and Kafka , and will contribute directly to ongoing data modernization efforts. While the work is not tied to life-critical systems, it is essential for advancing our long-term data strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

• Support FY26 initiatives focused on data-driven and personalized search experiences.

• Enhance current search and relevance models, which are presently generic and not tailored to individual users.

• Perform data assimilation related to athlete journey insights and integrate this information into downstream applications.

• Build and optimize data pipelines in collaboration with the broader Data Engineering team.

• Compile, transform, and prepare data for use across multiple business and technical functions.


Required Technical Skills:

• Strong hands-on experience with:

o Python

o Databricks (minimum 2-3 years required)

o Kafka

• Solid understanding of data engineering best practices and pipeline development.


Experience Requirements:

• 5+ years of overall experience in data engineering or related fields.

• Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work in cross-functional technical team.

title: Image & Video Annotator - 52974
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.


Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking creative and detail-oriented professionals with strong visual interpretation skills to help advance large multimodal AI systems. In this role, you will work on annotating and analyzing videos or images or both , capturing intricate details such as people, objects, environments, relationships, emotions, and storytelling flow.

Your work will directly contribute to training next-generation AI models to better perceive, interpret, and reason about the visual world—helping them understand scenes, motion, and context just as humans do.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze short video clips and images to identify and annotate key visual and narrative components, including subjects, settings, actions, and emotions.
  • Describe temporal sequences, scene transitions, and interactions in videos with high accuracy.
  • Label complex visual cues such as mood, lighting, and spatial relationships.
  • Follow detailed annotation guidelines to ensure consistency, clarity, and data quality.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, structure, and relevance.
  • Collaborate with project leads to align on evolving annotation standards and quality benchmarks.
  • Contribute structured datasets that improve AI model understanding of both static and dynamic visual information.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read, write and communicate in English with high comprehension skills.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to follow nuanced instructions with precision.
  • Technical Comfort: Familiarity with basic computer tools and working with file uploads/audio formats.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to understand context and intent in scripts.
  • Past experience in image/video annotation is preferred but is not necessary
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Availability: At least 20 hours/week is preferred—requirement to be finalized closer to the onboarding date.
  • Technical Setup and Equipment: Reliable computer (desktop/laptop) with stable internet connection.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 4 hours per day and 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking creative and detail-oriented professionals with strong visual interpretation skills to help advance large multimodal AI systems. In this role, you will work on annotating and analyzing videos or images or both , capturing intricate details such as people, objects, environments, relationships, emotions, and storytelling flow.

Your work will directly contribute to training next-generation AI models to better perceive, interpret, and reason about the visual world—helping them understand scenes, motion, and context just as humans do.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze short video clips and images to identify and annotate key visual and narrative components, including subjects, settings, actions, and emotions.
  • Describe temporal sequences, scene transitions, and interactions in videos with high accuracy.
  • Label complex visual cues such as mood, lighting, and spatial relationships.
  • Follow detailed annotation guidelines to ensure consistency, clarity, and data quality.
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, structure, and relevance.
  • Collaborate with project leads to align on evolving annotation standards and quality benchmarks.
  • Contribute structured datasets that improve AI model understanding of both static and dynamic visual information.


Requirements:

  • English Proficiency: Ability to read, write and communicate in English with high comprehension skills.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to follow nuanced instructions with precision.
  • Technical Comfort: Familiarity with basic computer tools and working with file uploads/audio formats.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to understand context and intent in scripts.
  • Past experience in image/video annotation is preferred but is not necessary
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Availability: At least 20 hours/week is preferred—requirement to be finalized closer to the onboarding date.
  • Technical Setup and Equipment: Reliable computer (desktop/laptop) with stable internet connection.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 4 hours per day and 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Hiring Immediately - Azure DevOps / Data Platform Engineer in (LATAM/Brazil, US EST Shift)


Technical Skills

  • Azure DevOps pipelines, Git repos, artifact management
  • Terraform, IaC governance patterns
  • Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, hierarchical namespace, ACL models
  • Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse, Spark
  • Azure Functions, Key Vault, networking (VNets, private endpoints, firewalls)
  • Monitoring stacks: Log Analytics, Application Insights, Azure Monitor
  • Scripting: PowerShell, Python, Bash
  • Security controls: RBAC, managed identities, secrets management, encryption
  • CI/CD patterns, release strategy design, automated testing frameworks
  • Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow


Support: US EST (Mon-Fri 9:00am-5:00pm)(Best Fit)

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Data Lake components: Data Factory, Databricks, Functions, Synapse, Spark workloads, storage configurations.
  • Implement Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform for provisioning storage accounts, networking, compute, identity, and security layers.
  • Enforce branching discipline, artifact integrity, automated testing, and controlled release gates.
  • Automate environment provisioning, ACL management, key rotation, lifecycle policies, and cluster configuration.
  • Integrate DevOps processes with enterprise security: RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, private networking, encryption controls.
  • Build observability: logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards for pipelines and platform components.
  • Maintain backup, restoration, disaster-recovery patterns and test them for reliability.
  • Eliminate configuration drift through standardized templates and environment baselines.
  • Maintain and optimize agents, service connections, and deployment runtimes.
  • Perform incident response and root-cause analysis, document systemic fixes.
  • Deliver reusable automation modules for data engineering teams.
  • Optimize workload performance and cost within the Data Lake environment.
  • Ensure compliance with governance, audit requirements, and data protection mandates.
  • Drive continuous reduction of manual operational work through automation.

title: Desenvolvedor Front End Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Conhecimentos necessários:


  • Conhecimentos e habilidades em algoritmos e estruturas de dados;
  • Domínio de engenharia de software, princípios, boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura;
  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento de aplicativos em React Native;
  • Conhecimento sólido em typescript;
  • Conhecimento sólido em versionamento de código (git/git flow);


Conhecimentos desejáveis:


  • Desenvolvimento mobile nativo (Java/Kotlin e Obj-C/Swift);
  • Experiência com CI/CD em aplicativos;
  • Publicação de aplicativos nas lojas (App Store/Google Play);
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativos White-label (Flavors e targets);
  • Testes para aplicativos em React Native (Jest, Detox, etc);
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações escaláveis, de alto desempenho e tolerantes à falha;

title: Laboratory Specialist (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. Compensation package - R$ 295 for 20 minutes online

description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remoto


A Blue Dot BPO conecta talentos LATAM a operações estratégicas de empresas norte-americanas. Estamos ampliando nosso time e buscamos um(a) Executive Recruiter com perfil hunter, forte experiência em recrutamento e capacidade de conduzir processos executivos de ponta a ponta. A posição é remota e voltada ao mercado dos Estados Unidos, com interação direta com lideranças sêniores.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$5.000 , com bônus adicionais em dólares.
  • Trabalho remoto em tempo integral, segunda a sexta, das 13h às 22h BRT .
  • Contrato de longo prazo, com oportunidades reais de crescimento.
  • Atuação estratégica junto a executivos e times de alto nível nos EUA.
  • Estrutura multicultural, orientada a performance, processos e meritocracia.


O que buscamos

  • 2+ anos de experiência em recrutamento , preferencialmente em posições executivas.
  • Perfil hunter, analítico e orientado a metas.
  • Inglês avançado (C1/C2) — comunicação diária com executivos norte-americanos.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para conduzir entrevistas estruturadas.
  • Vivência prática com LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, ATS e ferramentas de produtividade .
  • Organização, postura consultiva e presença profissional sólida.


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir processos full-cycle e realizar sourcing avançado para posições executivas.
  • Mapear mercados, empresas-alvo e talentos estratégicos para pipelines críticos.
  • Fazer pré-qualificação técnica e comportamental com profundidade e precisão.
  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de outreach (LinkedIn, e-mail etc.).
  • Gerenciar todo o ciclo de recrutamento: job postings, entrevistas, follow-up e handoff.
  • Coordenar entrevistas entre candidatos e equipes nos EUA.
  • Manter ATS e bancos de talentos atualizados, garantindo dados consistentes.
  • Atuar de forma estratégica, com ownership e disciplina operacional.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em executive recruiting de ciclo completo.
  • Familiaridade com práticas e mercado de recrutamento norte-americano.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Notebook com processador i7 (ou equivalente) e 12GB+ RAM .
  • Dois monitores para rotina operacional.
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset profissional.
  • Ambiente silencioso e estruturado para trabalho remoto.


Construa sua carreira internacional!


Se você deseja atuar diretamente com o mercado dos EUA, desenvolver experiência executiva e crescer em um ambiente orientado a alta performance, evolução contínua e consistência, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Front End Engineer
  • Location: Remote (Brazil)
  • Employment Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize web interfaces using ReactJS
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in UI development
  • Ensure responsive design and seamless performance across devices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve UI issues throughout development lifecycle

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with ReactJS :
  • Mid-Level: 3–4 years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Senior: 5+ years of hands-on ReactJS experience
  • Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5, CSS3, and related front-end tools
  • Experience with state management (Redux, Context API, etc.)
  • Knowledge of version control (Git) and agile development methodologies
  • Must currently be actively working with ReactJS technologies

title: Full stack Software Engineer – 100% Remote
description:
Full stack Software Engineer – 100% Remote

Location – Brazil

Rate – DOE

Start Date – Immediately


Job Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong experience in Java distributed systems and stream-based processing to join our engineering team You will design build and operate backend services that handle high through put workloads integrate with cloud platforms and support business critical applications

This role also involves working with Nodejs services CICD pipelines and modern infrastructure tooling including Kubernetes GitHub Actions AWS and GCP

Responsibilities Include

This is a critical role with a wide range of responsibilities including

Design implement and maintain distributed backend services using Java and Nodejs

Build and optimize message driven architectures and data pipelines using Apache Kafka

Develop scalable resilient APIs and backend services

Write clean maintainable and well tested code following industry best practices

Deploy monitor and support applications running on Kubernetes across cloud environments

Work closely with architects and product teams to design system components and integrations

Participate in code reviews system design discussions and operational readiness efforts

Troubleshoot production issues across services and infrastructure

Prototyping of new technologies to reduce cost and increase engineering velocity

Qualities Experience Were Seeking

We believe the right individual will have the following skills and experience to be successful in this role

A BS degree or higher in Engineering Computer Science or a related field is required

5 years of software engineering experience

Strong Java experience in backend or distributed systems environments

Handson experience with Kafka producers consumers partitions topics offsets stream processing etc

Proficiency in Nodejs for backend application development

Experience deploying and maintaining services running in Kubernetes

Familiarity with GitHub Actions for CICD

Handson experience with AWS and or GCP cloud platforms

Solid understanding of software design patterns system architecture and microservices principles

Experience working with MongoDB and PostgreSQL schema design performance considerations migrations

Strong debugging problem solving and communication skills

Excellent problem solving critical thinking and communication skills

Ability to work within a distributed team

Nice to have

VOD Streaming experience

Experience with React basic frontend integration work context management UI components

Exposure to infrastructure as code tools Terraform Helm etc

Monitoring observability tools Datadog NewRelic

title: Assistant Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Bilingual Recruiter Assistant (Fluent English – C1) | 100% Remoto

Na Blue Dot BPO, conectamos talentos LATAM a equipes executivas de alta performance em empresas norte-americanas. Estamos em busca de um(a) Recruiter Assistant com excelente comunicação em inglês, organização e proatividade para atuar em operações de recrutamento de alto volume. A posição é totalmente remota, voltada ao mercado dos EUA, com exposição diária a times globais e trilha clara de crescimento para quem deseja construir carreira em recrutamento.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração mensal de R$3.500 reais.
  • 100% remoto, atuando diretamente com equipes de recrutamento dos Estados Unidos.
  • Turno de segunda a sexta, das 13h às 22h BRT .
  • Oportunidade de crescimento acelerado (carreira em recrutamento executivo, liderança ou gestão).
  • Networking internacional + ambiente multicultural.
  • Treinamento remunerado e acompanhamento estruturado.


Suas responsabilidades

  • Apoiar o time de recrutamento do cliente (EUA) na busca e pré-qualificação de candidatos.
  • Realizar triagens iniciais via chamadas telefônicas, e-mail e mensagens.
  • Manter bases de dados atualizadas (job boards e ATS).
  • Redigir e atualizar job descriptions e perfis de vaga.
  • Mapear talentos em job boards e bancos de currículos.
  • Gerenciar agendas e apoiar o fluxo de comunicação entre candidatos e recrutadores.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas relacionadas à operação e organização do time de recrutamento.


O que buscamos

  • Inglês avançado (C1) — comunicação escrita e falada obrigatória.
  • Organização, foco e habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Perfil detalhista, proativo e orientado a entregas.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento ou talent acquisition.
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics ou outros ATS.
  • Vivência com operações de alto volume e prazos desafiadores.


Requisitos técnicos

  • Dois monitores | Processador i5/i7 (ou equivalente) | 12GB+ RAM .
  • Internet de alta velocidade.
  • Headset com microfone e ambiente silencioso.


Construa sua carreira em recrutamento!


Se você quer trabalhar diretamente com equipes dos EUA, adquirir experiência relevante e evoluir rapidamente, esta oportunidade é para você. Candidate-se e faça parte da Blue Dot BPO

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.



Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.


What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.


Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.


Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).


Evaluation Process:

  • Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.


After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.


We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at turing.com/referrals and earn money for successful referrals.

title: AI & Systems Associate
description:
Job description

  • Full Time
  • Remote
  • 3.400 USD


About Us

We are leading, women-owned VC firm investing in visionary and diverse founders at the pre-seed and seed stages. We have backed 100+ startups globally, including unicorn-caliber companies, and are now making a rare strategic hire to help build the internal operating system of our boutique, technology-driven firm.


Role Overview

You will work directly with the Partners across AI, operations, and systems design to build scalable internal workflows, automate processes, and bring structure to how we manage information, pipeline, and priorities. This is a deep-work , systems-focused role — not sourcing or events.


What You’ll Do

AI-Enabled Workflow Design

  • Audit existing tools (email, Slack, Notion, Airtable, CRM) and identify friction points.
  • Build AI-powered workflows for deal triage, research, summarization, communication drafts, and meeting synthesis.
  • Treat AI as a practical force multiplier focused on clarity and reliability.


Systems, Structure & Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain the firm’s operating spine using Airtable and other AI tools.
  • Create schemas, tagging systems, and playbooks for pipeline, portfolio, and stakeholder tracking.
  • Turn partner thinking into structured, searchable knowledge bases.


Automation & Integrations

  • Use tools like Zapier/Make and APIs to connect systems, reduce manual work, and keep data synchronized.
  • Maintain automations as tools and processes evolve.


Light Analytics & Reporting

  • Support Partners with insights for IC discussions, portfolio updates, and LP conversations.
  • Build simple dashboards or queries to answer recurring questions.


Special Projects

  • Own operational or strategic initiatives that increase Partner leverage (content engines, process codification, templates, checklists, event simplification).
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve.


Who You Are


AI-Native Builder

  • Uses AI in a structured way: workflows, prompts, systems thinking.
  • Knows when to rely on tools and when to think independently.


Systems-Minded

  • Naturally brings order to scattered information and undefined processes.
  • Enjoys turning chaos into documented flows usable by different work styles.


Independent Problem Solver

  • Takes vague problems and returns with structure, prototypes, and clear plans.
  • Communicates progress proactively and manages time autonomously.


Analytical & Clear Communicator

  • Understands trade-offs behind tools and workflows.
  • Writes concise, practical documentation for non-technical teammates.


Low-Ego, High-Ownership

  • Comfortable receiving direct feedback and driving adoption of new systems.


Qualifications

  • 2–7 years in operations, biz ops, product ops, RevOps, chief-of-staff, analytics, or similar roles in startups, tech, or investment firms.
  • Experience designing workflows/automations (Notion, Airtable, CRMs, Zapier/Make).
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools to transform workflows.
  • Comfort with data work (spreadsheets, basic queries; bonus for APIs/scripting).
  • Strong written communication; ability to work remote-first with high reliability.


Growth Path

For the right person, this role leads to:

  • Owning internal operating system end-to-end.
  • Becoming the firm’s AI + systems leader.
  • Influencing how we run investments, portfolio support, and LP communication.

Progress will be measured by:

  • Systems that drive adoption and real usage.
  • Clear improvements in time saved and decision quality.
  • Ability to anticipate needs and build before things break.

title: Backend Engineer, Salesforce Integration
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to take ownership of a Salesforce integration, enabling a seamless bidirectional data flow between Salesforce and our client’s core platform.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5–8+ years of backend engineering experience, ideally with Python (FastAPI or Flask) and AWS services.
  • Strong experience integrating with Salesforce APIs (REST, Bulk, Streaming, or GraphQL).
  • Understanding of OAuth2 flows, webhooks, and event-driven synchronization patterns.
  • Familiarity with multi-tenant architectures, data security best practices, and rate limit management.
  • Experience building resilient, scalable backend systems using cloud-native infrastructure (AWS Lambda, Databricks, DynamoDB, etc.).


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.


Bonus Qualifications


  • Knowledge of Salesforce AppExchange packaging or managed app development.
  • Experience with other SaaS integrations (HubSpot, Gmail, Slack).
  • Experience with data pipelines, enrichment, or analytics systems (We use Databricks)
  • Previous startup or SaaS platform experience.

title: AI/ML Specialist
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com AI/ML.


Responsabilidades Principais:


  • Projetar e implementar soluções complexas, escaláveis e seguras de IA na AWS, adaptadas às necessidades dos clientes
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e suporte para resolução de problemas durante a entrega dos projetos
  • Colaborar com as partes interessadas para levantar requisitos e propor estratégias eficazes de implementação de IA
  • Atuar como consultor de confiança para os clientes sobre tendências do setor e tecnologias emergentes em IA
  • Compartilhar conhecimento dentro da organização por meio de mentoria, treinamentos e criação de artefatos reutilizáveis


Requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em ciência da computação, engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de educação e experiência prática
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência relevante no desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos ou sistemas de machine learning ou deep learning em larga escala para produção, incluindo processamento de dados em batch e em tempo real
  • Conhecimento prático de IA generativa e experiência com prompt engineering, implantação e hospedagem de large foundational models
  • Experiência com serviços de IA da AWS, como SageMaker, Bedrock e outros serviços de machine learning
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de código em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, JavaScript, Python, etc.)

title: Visual Graphic Designer
description:
Hours: Flexible, part-time (approximately 20 hours per week)

Pay: $600 usd monthly.


Description :

Are you the kind of designer who loves turning raw ideas into clean, scroll-stopping content? Do you enjoy working across different brands and styles while keeping everything polished and on point? We’re hiring a Brand Visual Designer to create high-quality social media graphics for U.S.-based clients. You’ll work inside a dedicated pod with a marketing specialist, transforming content plans into strong visuals that perform. Part-time. Fully remote. Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING.


Key Responsibilities:

Design social media posts for Instagram and LinkedIn based on monthly content plans

Adapt designs to match each client’s brand identity and visual tone

Create carousels, single-image posts, and basic motion content when needed

Collaborate closely with the marketing specialist on concepts and revisions

Maintain consistent visual quality across all client accounts

Organize and deliver weekly design batches on deadline

Prepare final files for scheduling and publishing

Maintain clean project files and brand folders

Apply feedback quickly and accurately

Stay updated on social design trends and formats


Key Qualifications:

1+ years of experience in graphic design with a focus on digital or social media

Strong portfolio showing social media design work across multiple styles

Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or similar tools

Understanding of layout, typography, and visual hierarchy for social platforms

Comfortable designing within brand guidelines

Ability to manage multiple brands at the same time without losing quality

Strong attention to detail and time management

Must own and be able to use a working computer with high-speed internet

Must be ENGLISH-SPEAKING

title: Consultor ABAP/EWM
description:
Desenvolvedor ABAP/EWM (Expertise Tecnica em EWM)


Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor ABAP experiente, com forte expertise técnica em EWM p ara uma posição 100% remota - necessário inglês avançado/fluente .


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, construir, aprimorar e dar suporte aos processos SAP EWM utilizando ABAP.
  • Desenvolver e manter menus RF , interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms .
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e técnicas para garantir soluções EWM de alta qualidade.
  • Identificar, solucionar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos com postura proativa e foco em resolução.
  • Comunicar-se de forma eficaz com stakeholders em inglês.


Requisitos

  • E xperiência como Desenvolvedor ABAP Senior/Expert, com foco em desenvolvimento técnico EWM.
  • Sólida compreensão dos processos EWM e capacidade de projetá-los ou aprimorá-los.
  • Experiência em mais de uma implementação completa (full cycle).
  • Experiência prática e aprofundada em: (Desenvolvimento de RF-menu, Interfaces com dispositivos RF e Adobe Forms)
  • Forte capacidade analítica, resolução de problemas e boa comunicação.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar cobrindo principalmente o horário das 12h às 18/19h EST .
  • Inglês avaçado/fluente (falado e escrito).


Detalhes do Contrato

  • Tipo: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)
  • Duração: Mínimo de 5 meses , com possibilidade de extensão por até 1 ano *Renovável
  • Local: Remoto - Disponibilidade imediata para inicio frente aprovação .

We are currently searching for a Portuguese speaking Solution Architect/Developer to work with our biggest customer remotely in Brazil.


In this role you will leverage your technical expertise in Microsoft Teams and Viva to deliver proactive services and workshops to premier enterprise customers in Brazil.


The following proficiencies are required:


  • Fluent/native Portuguese written & oral communication
  • Design and development experience in major Viva components
  • Experience in integrating Viva with relevant technologies
  • Deep knowledge and experience in Teams Telephony and app development
  • Experience in customer and stakeholder management


If you are a seasoned professional, possessing the above proficiencies, please apply!


We look forward to receiving your applications.


Successful candidates will be contacted within 2 weeks of applying

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Before you apply, please get familiar with Luxoft


  • Luxoft locations:
  • Logeek Magazine:
  • Luxoft Alumni Club:


Responsibilities:


  • Design and implement scalable data pipelines using Databricks and Kafka
  • Build and maintain real-time streaming solutions for high-volume data
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate data flows into broader systems
  • Optimize performance and reliability of data processing workflows
  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and compliance across streaming and batch pipelines
  • Participate in agile development processes and contribute to technical documentation


Mandatory Skills Description:


  • +5 years of experience in data engineering roles
  • Proven expertise with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, notebooks, performance tuning)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka (topics, producers/consumers, schema registry)
  • Solid understanding of streaming frameworks (e.g., Spark Structured Streaming, Flink, or similar)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Proficiency in Python or Scala for data pipeline development
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, Jenkins) and agile tools (Jira)
  • Exposure to data lakehouse architectures and best practices
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and observability


Project Description:


  • We are seeking a skilled and hands-on Data Engineer with proven experience in Databricks, Apache Kafka, and real-time data streaming solutions.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Sr. Full-Stack Engineer (Java/React)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


We are seeking a highly-skilled Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer  to join these high-impact teams. You will collaborate closely with design, product, and engineering experts to deliver innovative, real-time solutions that elevate our partners' retail offerings.


What You’ll Do:

You will be expected to operate as a full-stack owner, driving development from the database to the user interface, with a strong commitment to quality and collaboration.

  • Lead the development of high-quality, robust, observable, and measurable applications using a user-centric approach and disciplined eXtreme Programming (XP) practices .
  • Practice Test-Driven Development (TDD)  and Pair Programming  as core, daily engineering functions to ensure code quality and shared ownership.
  • Contribute across the stack, developing business logic with Java/Spring Boot  on the backend and building intuitive user interfaces with React  on the frontend.
  • Design and implement scalable, event-driven solutions utilizing Kafka .
  • Participate in the entire Agile application lifecycle in collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers.
  • Leverage critical thinking, experimentation, data, and industry best practices to implement desired business outcomes.
  • Facilitate team ceremonies and actively give and receive feedback that is empathetic, actionable, and specific.
  • Practice emergent architecture with sane defaults and build software that is easy to use and easy to modify.
  • Lead technical initiatives not only on the team but also across the department.


Team Focus Areas:

Engineers will be assigned to collaborate on the following mission-critical teams focused on modernizing core retail functions. You will be instrumental in the following key initiatives:

Merchandising Systems Modernization
  • Merchandise Assortment Planning (MAP):  Build and extend platform interfaces to capture data in software (not spreadsheets), enabling better downstream decision-making.
  • Merchandising Financial Planning:  Focus on improving data consistency and quality across major merchandising systems.
Optimization and Allocation Systems
  • Order Optimization:  Address intersystem data issues. A key goal is to replace a vendor's size/pack optimization product (SAS) and modernize existing services to use a real-time data source (via Kafka) instead of batch processes.
  • Replenishment:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown ARC  system.
  • Allocations:  Iterate on and enhance functionality in the new homegrown KOALA  system.


Skills You Have:

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java and JEE development, particularly Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Spring Security.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.
Preferred Skills
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Experience with large-scale application troubleshooting and performance tuning.
  • Exposure to major cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Experience with microservices architecture.


Essential Functions:

The requirements listed below are representative of functions you may be required to perform; however, you may be required to perform additional functions. To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship.

  • Ability to perform the accountabilities listed in the “What You’ll Do” section.
  • Ability to comply with dress code requirements.
  • Basic math and reading skills, legible handwriting, and basic computer operation.
  • Ability to maintain prompt and regular attendance and meet scheduling requirements as set by our partner.
  • Ability to learn and comply with all company policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.
  • Ability to give direction and to receive, understand, and proactively respond to direction from leadership and other company personnel.
  • Ability to work as part of a team and interact effectively and appropriately with others.
  • Ability to maintain composure and work in a fast-paced environment while accomplishing multiple tasks within established timeframes.
  • Ability to satisfactorily complete company training programs.
  • Ability to use a personal computer for tasks such as communicating and preparing reports.
  • Ability to plan, prioritize, and monitor activities across business units.
  • Ability to complete or oversee the completion of assigned projects in a timely manner.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


Role duration:  6 months with option to renew


Core hours:  9 am - 5 pm US Central Time Zone


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Data Scientist - Scheduling Optimization
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsabilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Desenvolvedor Java PL
description:
Quem Somos

“A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento industrial.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Profissional responsável por desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações Java, assegurando estabilidade, performance, segurança e qualidade técnica.

Atuará tanto em sistemas modernos quanto em soluções legadas, exigindo capacidade de leitura de código pré-existente, raciocínio investigativo e habilidade para trabalhar com informações limitadas.

Também será responsável por integrar aplicações internas e externas, otimizar rotinas de banco de dados e garantir aderência às regras de negócio e padrões arquiteturais estabelecidos.

• Investigar e identificar causas raízes de problemas utilizando logs, métricas, comportamento da aplicação e leitura de código.

• Desenvolver e manter APIs, componentes backend e integrações entre sistemas.

• Propor, implementar e validar soluções robustas e eficientes, garantindo qualidade, segurança e estabilidade.

• Evoluir sistemas existentes, preservando compatibilidade com soluções legadas.

• Realizar ajustes estruturais e otimizações de desempenho.

• Apoiar squads internos (negócio, infraestrutura, QA) para garantir fluidez na entrega e operação diária.

• Participar de code reviews, boas práticas de engenharia e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência sólida com Java 8+ em ambientes corporativos.

• Domínio de frameworks como Spring, Spring Boot, Spring MVC.

• Implementação de APIs REST e SOAP com boas práticas de segurança e versionamento.

• Experiência com servidores de aplicação: Tomcat, WildFly/JBoss ou equivalentes.

• Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST/SOAP.

• Manipulação de arquivos CSV, TXT, XML.

• Familiaridade com integrações legadas e arquiteturas híbridas.

• SQL avançado: joins complexos, triggers, views, procedures.

• Experiência com Oracle, SQL Server ou PostgreSQL.

• Capacidade de tuning, otimização de consultas e análise de planos de execução.

• Construção e manutenção de scripts e rotinas de banco.

• Uso de ferramentas de versionamento, especialmente Git.

• Conhecimento de logs, monitoramento e ferramentas de troubleshooting.

• Experiência com ambientes Linux e execução de serviços Java.

Soft skills: Perfil Comportamental

• Raciocínio analítico e foco em resolução estruturada de problemas.

• Organização e clareza na documentação técnica.

• Boa comunicação com áreas técnicas, de negócio e demais stakeholders.

• Proatividade e autonomia diante de cenários com documentação limitada.

• Conforto para trabalhar com código legado, mantendo disciplina e visão de melhoria contínua.

• Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas e mudanças de prioridade.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime Remoto.


Modelo de contratação

Contrato flexível
